explanation: The custom Arrow data serializer (which worked around the zero-copy slice pickling bug in Arrow < 8.0.0) has been removed, but the change adds `copy=True` to the slice call to force a buffer-level copy at shuffle time; if any other slice call site was missed or if the copied slices are later re-sliced without copying, the underlying serialization bug can still cause oversized or incorrect data to be sent over the wire.
